name: WENTEL
recent: Wentel 宣布每股 0.5 仙的第一次中期单层股息，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 10 日。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。近期有多项董事及主要股东权益变动的申报。
notable: 宣布第一次中期单层股息每股 0.5 仙。
发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 3723 万令吉，环比增长 17.1%，同比增长 6.8%；净利为 667.9 万令吉，环比增长 145.6%，同比增长 32.9%；净利率为 17.9%，高于上一季度的 8.6%。

recent_en: Wentel declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 Dec 2026. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026. There were several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests recently.
notable_en: Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share.
Released quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 37.23 million, up 17.1% QoQ and 6.8% YoY; net income was MYR 6.679 million, up 145.6% QoQ and 32.9% YoY; net margin was 17.9%, higher than 8.6% in the previous quarter.
